description: Which honua-sdk-dotnet markdown is part of the Open Knowledge Format bundle, and which is deliberately not. Consumed by scripts/check-okf-bundle.py.

spec.name: Open Knowledge Format
spec.note: One markdown file is one concept; the file path is the concept's identity; relative markdown links are the graph edges. `type` is the only required frontmatter field.

workstream: WS9 — the other nine repositories. honua-sdk-dotnet is third, after geospatial-grpc and honua-sdk-python.

conceptTypes.index: A section entry point. Enumerates what the directory holds so a reader or agent can choose before opening.
conceptTypes.concept: What a thing is and how it fits. No procedure.
conceptTypes.guide: A task someone performs, start to finish.
conceptTypes.reference: Lookup material: surfaces, options, contracts, matrices.

excludedDirs.why: Its own README says it plainly: these are written for contributors and cross-repo maintainers, covering backlog, contract harmonization, transport ownership and release cadence. One of them is labelled a historical planning snapshot. None of it is documentation about using the SDK.

excludedFiles.why: GitBook's table of contents, generated from this bundle by scripts/generate-summary.py. It is navigation OVER the bundle, not a concept in it - the same reason honua-server excludes its own SUMMARY.md.
How maintainers cut a release from the shared version source in Directory.Build.props. Release mechanics, not consumption.
The certification lane that proves public SDK operations against a server. CI apparatus; its output is the evidence, not this page.
How the staging suite is configured and what it needs from the deployed fixture. Contributor and platform-maintainer coordination.
The SDK-side Testcontainers suite, skipped by default. Describes this repository's own tests rather than anything a consumer calls.
The checked-in public-API approval files every shipped project carries and how to update them. A contributor workflow enforced by an analyzer.

Prose around contracts/sdk-coverage.v1.json, this SDK's producer snapshot for honua-server's cross-product capability matrix. Generated evidence feeding another repository's gate, the same reason honua-server excludes docs/gis.
Tracks issue #128, a .NET-first demo suite that does not exist yet. A plan for documentation rather than documentation; it joins the bundle when the suite it describes ships.

rejectedFields.timestamp: Not an OKF field in any version. The trust family spells the build stamp `generated`. Rejected by name here so the v0.1-shaped mistake honua-site shipped until 2026-09-10 cannot spread into this bundle.

boundaryNote: This repo had already drawn the line once, in docs/internal — that directory's own README says it is for contributors and cross-repo maintainers. The seven additional exclusions are the same kind of page that simply never moved there: release mechanics, CI lanes, the SDK's own test suites, a generated coverage snapshot, and a demo suite that is still an issue rather than a suite.
